messages:
Ivy: Quick logistics note 10:00 PT start. We moved the roadmap Q&A slot to 10:35 so we can handle 2 extra finance items first. Presenters: please be in the "Presenters" Zoom 5m early.
Ben: Heads-up 10:03  we had a caption dropout last time. Any config changes since then?
Hannah: I swapped the RTMP bridge yesterday to fix latency. Reverted caption passthrough to previous setting but will run a check.
stream-bot: Stream service (us-west-2)  HEALTHY. Encoder versions: [v2.1.4]. Caption service latency 110ms. Next maintenance window 03:00 UTC.
Ethan: Can we enable dual recording (OBS local + cloud) as fallback? Last town hall only cloud had the full recording.
Hannah: Yes, local OBS backup will be running on "hannah-mbp". I'll also export the OBS scene: obs-cli scenes export --scene "AH_Presenter" --file /tmp/ah.json
Ivy: Also, calendar updated with new agenda and pinned it in #all-hands-notes. Please avoid sharing embargoed slides; mark them as internal-only.
Ben: Zoom version check: everyone presenting please run zoom --version and paste here. If anyone's on <5.14 we need them to upgrade.
Hannah: I'm on 5.14.9 macOS. OBS key matches, RTMP bridge ok. Starting dry-run in 6m.
stream-bot: Recording started at 10:01:12 PT. File: s3://redwood-allhands/2026-04-12/1762500000-recording.mp4 :white_check_mark: 
Ivy: For the live Q&A hosts: ask people to raise hands and copy a one-line version into chat. Mike will curate top 6. We'll open follow-up threads for any unanswered items.
Ethan: I'll monitor eng-oncall and post a pinned note in the meeting thread if we flip to audio-only.
Ivy: Thanks everyone 10:05. See you shortly.
